scale: 1 = critical exposure; 2 = major issues; 3 = moderate issues; 4 = minor inherited issues; 5 = no issue identified in the reviewed scope
summary: The new platform console uses current verified platform authority, sanitized bounded administration DTOs and explicit hotel action boundaries. Local operator/ordinary-user emulator and real import replay checks pass. This is a scoped repository review by the implementing agent, not an independent reviewer attestation or production security certification.

findings.issue: Inherited operational configuration CRUD rules require licensed action authority but lack complete field/type/size schemas. This remains isolated to a permitted user's hotel and is outside the platform metadata work.
findings.recommendation: Define existing location/outlet payload contracts in a separate focused hardening change and enforce bounded create/update validation with normal-user and malformed-payload regressions.

checks.result: Browser create/update/delete of memberships, profiles, platform telemetry/policies/audit/sessions/incidents and hotel-root metadata are denied, including to platform tokens. Backend mutation revisions and source ownership are server-selected. Audit copies commit with the mutation.

Every new platform callable checks verified ID-token identity and current enabled verified Auth platform authority. Payload fields do not grant authority. Hotel operational callables and Rules require canonical membership, licensed module and action; platform claims do not bypass those checks.

Zero-hotel operators can use the exported platform callable wrappers and create hotels without operational assignment. Ordinary permitted hotel Firestore/Storage reads succeed; cross-hotel, unverified, disabled and live-revoked platform requests fail. Support actor/hotel/expiry and actual checkpoint-preserving parser recovery are covered.

Platform queries, policies, reasons, names, pages, historical occurrence reconciliation and cleanup batches are bounded. Upload limits and declared image/import MIME restrictions remain. No platform path exposes source bytes or grants broad recursive Storage access.

Monitoring validates known keys, IANA time zones, exact business dates, weekdays, booleans, finite bounded integer offsets/grace and optimistic revisions. Missing counts/dates/times stay unknown; invalid stored assignments block editing instead of becoming an empty assignment.

DTOs whitelist administration/contact/status evidence and exclude raw guest/source/credential/mail payloads. Profile reads are owner-only in browser Rules; global directory access is an authorized backend projection. Source hotel and generation are checked independently of the session or caller payload.

review_corrections: Removed blanket platform operational bypasses and automatic creator hotel assignment.
Fenced obsolete hotel responses, support redirects and actions; rejected unavailable user-record saves.
Kept required downstream model work pending/partial/unknown until evidenced complete.
Separated business import completion from optional telemetry persistence failures.
Kept incident expectations immutable across policy revisions and prevented older checks overwriting newer evidence.
Preserved source checkpoints; blocked leased/completed runs and replacement source generations; rechecked live authority after storage I/O.
Restored expired support stays denied; zero-hotel operator Auth authority and platform metadata survive the restore fixture.
Scoped hotel team state is reset on hotel changes; unmounted saves cannot refresh or populate another hotel.

evidence.frontend: 693 passing frontend tests across 78 files in the final complete run.
evidence.security: 126 passing Auth/Firestore/Storage emulator tests across 17 suites, including immutable original-policy incident recovery and real Storage/parser/Firestore replay.
evidence.restore: Two-hotel Auth/Firestore/private Storage export/import with platform records, zero-hotel operator and restored expired-session denial passed.
evidence.builds: Lint, boundary type checking, generated Rules, shell syntax, dependency gate and both fictional test/App Hosting builds passed.
evidence.status: Code implemented and locally checked; no merge, deployment or production acceptance performed.

limitations: Firebase Rules enforce token identity and current canonical memberships rather than querying live Auth disabled state. For direct operational access, use canonical membership removal as the immediate revocation control; backend callables also check live Auth.
Emulator tests do not establish production Rules propagation, GCS versioning/IAM behavior, real mail/provider delivery or scheduler operation.
Responsive browser visual acceptance was blocked in this runner by an absent Chromium executable; component workflow tests pass.
A separate human PR review remains required before the owner chooses a production release.
